reviewers.role: Prüferin (lizenzierte Goethe-A2-Prüferin): exam fidelity, rubric application, task clarity
Kursleiterin DaF/DaZ, Niveau A2.2: naturalness, level, didactics, scene plausibility

method: We read every German string again: start, LS1-LS3 inputs, items, pools, reserves, micro-outputs and Aussprache; LS4 texts, blocks and strategy cards; the LS5 and LS6 Aufgaben; check, proofs, redemittel, story, fokus and facts. We solved every item blind from promptDe plus its options, tiles or audio line, and compared the result with answer and accepted[]. We checked h1, l4, s1 and sp3 against content/course-v2/registries/lanes/ga2.json. We checked the grammar ceiling against grammar-spine.json, the lexicon against a2.2/lexicon.json, a2.2/specs.json, curriculum/a2-2.md E4 and level-profiles.json, the can-dos against registries/cando/a2.json, the cast against casts/a2.json and casts/series.json, the rule cards against a2.2/rule-cards.json, and dictation matching against src/lib/lesson/check.js. Each of the 20 r1 findings was re-verified. Validator: node scripts/course-v2/validate.mjs content/course-v2/a2.2/units/u04.json returned FAIL. It found 1 LEX-05 blocker, 30 LEX-01/LEX-02 ratchets and 7 GRM-04 advisories. LEX-03 now passes. The first two runs crashed with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND (lib-validate/core-lexicon.mjs) while another agent was writing that file; the third run completed and is the one quoted here. node scripts/course-v2/check.mjs on the unit returned 0 errors.
verdict: Not exitable in round 2. 16 of the 20 r1 findings are fixed in the unit: F01 (the rule was fixed), F03, F05, F06, F07 (the stimulus), F09 (t9), F11-F15, F17-F20. The story geography is now consistent. The Sprechen Teil 3 stimulus is now two genuine one-day calendars with a single shared window (14-17 Uhr). gegenüber + dem is accepted. The LS1/LS3 Aussprache and the LS6 situation are repaired. Four r1 findings are only half-closed. F08: the unit dropped lx.entlang, but lexicon.json and specs.json still allocate it, so LEX-05 fails. F02: the unit explanations were fixed, but rc.werden-vollverb still says "er wird – ohne d" and now contradicts them on the same screen. F04: Rettungswagen/Rettungsdienst are still not accepted. F10: there is still no l4 Beispiel. New in round 2: a persona contradiction introduced by the F12 fix (Arjun is Priya's husband, not "ein Freund"); two defensible answers not accepted in graded items (q05 word order, ls3-r04 preposition); and a number-word dictation (c07) that rejects "10". Counts: 1 blocker (validator), 6 major, 9 minor. Exam fidelity is otherwise sound: h1, l4, s1 and sp3 match ga2.json, every key was verified blind, and no task copies a Modellsatz.

findings.quote: LEX-05 x lexicon.json allocates to a2.2-u04 but the spec's blocks omit: lx.entlang · LEX-01/02 ~ productive lemma „entlang" occurs 0× in the unit's inputs · unit block 1: ["lx.treffpunkt", "lx.folgen", …]
findings.problem: validate.mjs FAILs the unit on LEX-05. The unit correctly dropped lx.entlang: curriculum/a2-2.md E4 says entlang is not taught here, and grammar-spine.json licenses g.praep-entlang-herum only from b1.2-u09. But a2.2/lexicon.json still allocates lx.entlang as productive to a2.2-u04, and specs.json still lists it, so the three sources disagree. The unit filled the gap with lx.treffpunkt, which is an A1.2 lemma (a1.2/lexicon.json, a1.2/specs.json). It is not a new A2.2 word, so block 1 is now double-allocated across levels, and the unit's spec differs from specs.json. The lexicon example for lx.fluss ("Der Weg geht immer am Fluss entlang.") also teaches entlang at this level.
findings.fix: Lexicon/spec owner: remove lx.entlang from a2.2/lexicon.json (it belongs in B1.2, spine g.praep-entlang-herum) and from specs.json a2.2-u04 block 1. Change lx.fluss.example to "Wir wandern am Fluss." Unit: remove lx.treffpunkt from lexiconBlocks[0]. Either leave block 1 at 9, since 28 new words is still inside newPerUnit [22, 30] and 14 productive of 28 = 0.5, or allocate a genuinely new lemma the unit already uses. lx.nass (LS2 l05, currently glossed, allocated nowhere) would fit. Mirror the choice in specs.json.
findings.proposedRule: LEX-05 also fails when spec.lexiconBlocks lists a lemma whose lexicon allocation is at an earlier level (cross-level double allocation). LEX-07 flags lexicon examples that use a spine point licensed after the entry's unit (fixture: lx.fluss example with entlang at a2.2-u04).

findings.quote: „Achtung: du wirst und er wird – ohne d am Ende." · en: "du wirst, er wird (no -d)"
findings.problem: r1 F02 fixed the unit's three explanations but not the rule card they come from. The card still teaches that er wird has no d, which is false. LS2 now shows the card and then items that say the opposite ("es wird – mit d am Ende, aber ohne t"), so the learner sees two contradicting rules for the same form in one Lernschritt. A false simplification on a rule card is a D-criterion error (§9.4, §9.5).
findings.fix: Rule-card owner: de "Achtung: du wirst (ohne d), er/sie/es wird (mit d, ohne t)." en "Note: du wirst (no d), er/sie/es wird (d, no t)." The unit cannot exit while LS2 shows the current card.
findings.proposedRule: Rule-card and explanation lint (as in r1): a text that pairs a token ending in d (wird) with "ohne d" / "no -d" fails. Fixtures: the current rc.werden-vollverb de and en.

findings.quote: tiles ["gehen Sie","an der Tankstelle","vorbei","und","biegen Sie","am Kiosk","links ab"] · accepted: ["Gehen Sie an der Tankstelle vorbei und biegen Sie am Kiosk links ab."]
findings.problem: Solved blind, this proof item has two defensible answers that are not accepted. (1) "Gehen Sie an der Tankstelle vorbei und am Kiosk biegen Sie links ab." is built from the same tiles. The second conjunct is the V2 statement form that German directions use all the time ("Am Kiosk biegen Sie links ab"). (2) The German prompt ("Eine Frau fragt Sie nach dem Weg zur Brücke. Erklären Sie ihn.") does not give the route, so "Biegen Sie am Kiosk links ab und gehen Sie an der Tankstelle vorbei." is also a correct sentence. It is only wrong against a route the item never states. This item proves cd.a2.weg-erklaeren, so a learner who explains the way correctly fails the can-do. ITM-09 passed it, so the gate misses reorders inside an und-conjunct. q04 has the same weakness in a milder form: "Mein Nachbar kann nicht aufstehen und ist auf der Straße ausgerutscht." is grammatical.
findings.fix: q05 promptDe: "Eine Frau fragt Sie nach dem Weg zur Brücke. Zuerst kommt die Tankstelle, dann der Kiosk. Erklären Sie ihr den Weg." Add "Gehen Sie an der Tankstelle vorbei und am Kiosk biegen Sie links ab." to accepted[] with acceptedWhy "auch richtig: im zweiten Teil ein Aussagesatz mit Sie". q04: either put the order in the prompt ("Sagen Sie zuerst, was passiert ist.") or accept the swapped order.
findings.proposedRule: ITM-09 enumerates, for each conjunct joined by an "und" tile, every V2 order of that conjunct (including a fronted adverbial after "und") and requires each grammatical order to be accepted or excluded by promptDe. Fixture: q05.

findings.quote: promptDe: „Emre wartet ___ Brücke auf den Krankenwagen." · promptEn: "Wo? an + die Brücke." · accepted: ["an der"]
findings.problem: The German prompt leaves the preposition open, so "auf der", "vor der" and "bei der" are all correct Wo? answers ("Emre wartet auf der Brücke" is as natural as "an der Brücke"). The input does not decide it either: the dispatcher says "schicken Sie bitte jemanden zur Brücke … dort warten". Only the English prompt gives "an". This reserve item feeds the plateau, mehr-ueben and repair banks, so the learner is graded on it.
findings.fix: Cue the preposition in German: "Emre wartet ___ Brücke auf den Krankenwagen. (an)". Alternatively, make it multiple_choice like ls1-r03 with the options an der / an die / zur.
findings.proposedRule: ITM-01: a fill_blank whose key begins with a preposition must have that preposition in promptDe (as a cue in brackets or fixed by the frame, as in "bis ___" or "gegenüber ___"). A preposition that appears only in promptEn fails. Fixture: ls3-r04.

findings.quote: „Tomasz ruft die 112 an. Bald kommt der ___ und bringt Lina ins Krankenhaus." · accepted: ["Krankenwagen"]
findings.problem: Half of r1 F04 was applied. The new frame now excludes Notarzt, but "Rettungswagen" is still not accepted, although the r1 fix asked for it. "Rettungsdienst" is also correct. Both words are printed on every German ambulance, and learners living in Germany use them. A defensible second answer that is not accepted is MAJOR under §9.4.
findings.fix: accepted: ["Krankenwagen", "Rettungswagen", "Rettungsdienst"], acceptedWhy {"Rettungswagen": "auch richtig, das Wort für den Notfall", "Rettungsdienst": "auch richtig"}, reviewerConfirmed as the schema requires.

findings.quote: „Arjun, ein Freund von Priya, kommt zum ersten Mal mit."
findings.problem: This contradicts the cast. casts/series.json has Arjun as "Priyas Mann". a2.2-u03 is Priya and Arjun's weekend in Dresden, and this unit's own l4 item 1 has "Priya und Arjun haben am Samstag frei". The r1 F12 fix introduced the error. §9.4 counts a persona contradiction as MAJOR.
findings.fix: "Arjun, der Mann von Priya, kommt zum ersten Mal mit. Er fährt mit der Straßenbahn und kennt den Weg nicht." The rest of the task stays as it is.

findings.path: check.items[6] (a2.2-u04-c07, dictation); generated dictation from steps[2].input.lines[8] (ls3-l09)
findings.quote: answer/accepted: ["Wir sind am Ufer hinter dem Hügel, zehn Minuten von der Brücke."]
findings.problem: A learner who writes "… 10 Minuten von der Brücke." has transcribed the audio correctly but is marked wrong in a check item. normalizeDictation in src/lib/lesson/check.js folds only digit grouping, not number words to digits. The unit itself treats zehn and 10 as equal in ls3-i03 (accepted ["zehn", "10"], exact: number). The dictation generator's source ls3-l09 ("in zehn Minuten") has the same exposure.
findings.fix: Unit: add "Wir sind am Ufer hinter dem Hügel, 10 Minuten von der Brücke." to c07 accepted[] with acceptedWhy "Zahl als Ziffer ist auch richtig". Class: the checker's dictation mode folds the number words null to zwölf to digits, or ITM-07 requires a digit variant for every dictation whose answer contains a number word.
findings.proposedRule: ITM-07 extension: a dictation item (or a dictation.fromInput source line) whose answer contains a number word from NUMBER_WORDS must accept the digit variant, or the checker must fold the two. Fixture: c07.

findings.quote: „Eine Freundin steht an der Haltestelle vor Ihrem Haus. Sie findet Ihre Wohnung nicht." · promptDe „Wo geht sie vorbei? Wo biegt sie ab?"
findings.problem: If the stop is in front of the learner's house, there is nothing to walk past and nowhere to turn, so the situation contradicts its own prompt. The learner has to ignore the situation to produce the target structures.
findings.fix: "Eine Freundin steht an der Haltestelle am Marktplatz. Ihre Wohnung ist fünf Minuten zu Fuß von dort. Sie findet den Weg nicht."

findings.quote: learner: „Am Vormittag kann ich leider nicht. Ab 14 Uhr habe ich Zeit." – partner: „Ab 14 Uhr passt es bei mir." … learner: „Wollen wir eine Wanderung am Fluss machen?"
findings.problem: The stimulus is now right, but the model agrees on the time in one exchange. It never shows the behaviour Sprechen Teil 3 scores: proposing a time, being refused with a reason, and making a counter-proposal. aiRole.personaDe even says Amal "lehnt eine Uhrzeit … ab". Also, the model learner proposes a hike although situationDe has just said that Lina cannot walk far.
findings.fix: Turns 1-4: learner "Hast du um 10 Uhr Zeit?" – Amal "Um 10 kann ich leider nicht, da bringe ich Rania zum Schwimmkurs. Und am Nachmittag?" – learner "Um 14 Uhr?" – Amal "Ja, aber um 17 Uhr muss ich zu Hause sein." Then replace the hike with "Wollen wir ein Picknick im Park machen?" and keep Amal's boat counter-proposal.

findings.problem: The key option contains a genitive attribute (der Straße). grammar-spine.json licenses g.genitiv from b1.1-u11. It is receptive and understandable as a chunk, but it is on the key, and a plainer form exists.
findings.fix: "auf der anderen Straßenseite" (and the same in the explanation).

findings.quote: „Wir warten an der Brücke. Du gehst bis ___ Brücke." · „Gehen Sie bis ___ Ampel und dann rechts." · accepted: ["zur", "zu der"]
findings.problem: "bis an die Brücke" / "bis an die Ampel" is also standard German, and p02's first sentence ("an der Brücke") primes it. Only promptEn ("bis zu + …") excludes it. An A2.2 learner is unlikely to produce it, so this is minor.
findings.fix: Cue zu in German: "Du gehst bis ___ Brücke. (zu)" and "Gehen Sie bis ___ Ampel (zu) und dann rechts." Alternatively, accept "an die" with acceptedWhy.

findings.path: steps[2].pool.items[10] (ls3-p11).explanation.de; steps[2].reserve[2] (ls3-r03).promptDe; steps[6].endLine; steps[3].texts[7] (t8) title vs text
findings.quote: „Am Notruf fragt man Sie zuerst …" · „Am Notruf fragt man: …" · „… den Anweisungen am Notruf folgen." · t8 title „Erste Hilfe am Samstag" / heading „Erste Hilfe – Kurs an einem Tag"
findings.problem: Small wording issues. "Beim Notruf" is the standard preposition; "am Notruf" reads as a place. The t8 title and the ad's own heading differ. The heading is also better written as the compound the unit itself teaches in LS2 (Erste-Hilfe-Kurs).
findings.fix: "Beim Notruf fragt man Sie zuerst: Wo sind Sie?" · "Beim Notruf fragt man: …" · endLine "… und beim Notruf die Anweisungen verstehen." · t8 heading "Erste-Hilfe-Kurs an einem Tag" and title "Erste-Hilfe-Kurs am Samstag".

findings.problem: Carried over from r1 F10. In the official format the Beispiel uses up one ad, leaving one unused. Here two ads (d, e) are unused, which makes the X item slightly easier. SCHEMA still has no block.example, so the unit cannot fix this alone.
findings.fix: Schema/template owner: model block.example ({promptDe, answer, textRef}) for ga2.l4 and EXM-01. The unit then adds "0 Familie Weber sucht einen Kurs für Eltern mit Babys." → d.
findings.proposedRule: EXM-01: when a Teil template's source says the example consumes an option, the block must carry block.example and the unused-option count must equal options − items − 1 + (noMatch ? 1 : 0).

findings.quote: „Zum Durchgangsarzt muss man, wenn die Verletzung über den Unfalltag hinaus arbeitsunfähig macht oder die Behandlung voraussichtlich länger als eine Woche dauert."
findings.problem: The claim reads as exhaustive. To our knowledge the D-Arzt duty in the Vertrag Ärzte/Unfallversicherungsträger (§ 26) also covers the prescription of Heil- or Hilfsmittel and recurring illness from the accident. Under §9.5, a fact must be complete, with its exceptions. The learner-facing bodyDe is not affected. We could not re-open the sources from this session.
findings.fix: "… unter anderem, wenn …". Alternatively, add the Heil-/Hilfsmittel trigger with § 26 ÄV as a source, then re-verify and re-stamp factsCheckedOn.

findings.problem: Only Pfund|Fund is a clean pf/f minimal pair. In Pfanne|Fahne the vowel length also differs (short a / long a), and in Pferd|fährt the vowel quality can differ (e: / ɛ:). A learner can pick the right word by the vowel and never hear pf.
findings.fix: Keep Pfund|Fund and add pf/p pairs with the same vowel, such as Pfanne|Panne. If a third pair is needed, use Pfeffer in a perception item (pf at the start and inside the word).

findings.quote: det.zustandspassiv „sind … verletzt", „ist … gebrochen", q02/rm04 „ist … verletzt"; det.adjektiv-endung-nullartikel „eine" (t4), „unser" (t7); det.konjunktiv1 „Park gehe" · t10: „Große Wanderung … über Hügel und steile Wege"
findings.problem: All 7 advisories are false positives. verletzt and gebrochen sein are adjectival. In q02/rm04 the pattern spans two clauses (ist ausgerutscht … hat sich verletzt). "eine Jacke" and "unser Boot" have no adjective, and gehe is a 1st-person indicative. The one real look-ahead is not flagged: t10 "über Hügel und steile Wege" and the heading "Große Wanderung" use adjective endings without an article, which g.adj-dekl-nullartikel licenses only from a2.2-u05. It is receptive, in an exam ad.
findings.fix: Unit: t10 "Die Wanderung dauert acht Stunden. Die Wege sind oft steil, und es geht über viele Hügel." with title "Die große Wanderung" or "Wanderung für Sportliche". Rule side: tune the detectors (see proposedRule).
findings.proposedRule: det.adjektiv-endung-nullartikel: require an attributive adjective followed by a noun with no determiner (fixture positive: "über Hügel und steile Wege"; negatives: "lieber eine Jacke", "auf unser Boot"). det.zustandspassiv: do not match across a clause boundary or a coordinating und (negative: "ist ausgerutscht und hat sich … verletzt"), and treat verletzt/gebrochen/kaputt + sein as adjectival. det.konjunktiv1: exempt 1st person singular.

passed: ga2.h1: 5 texts (radio, Mailbox, Durchsage, radio, Anrufbeantworter), 3 options each, plays 2 and the instruction says zweimal, 53-60 words (band 35-75), modeDefault pruefung. Keys solved blind: Zoo-Brücke, Kuchen, gegenüber vom Rathaus, Es regnet, Brücke gegenüber vom Museum. Each distractor is heard but does not answer the question.

ga2.l4: 5 items, 6 ads a-f, noMatch X, ads 35-41 words (about 230 in total, band 25-45 each). Keys solved blind: a, f, b, c, X. Distractors d (Mittwoch, Eltern) and e (one-day hike, no hut) are excluded by the day, the audience or the duration.

ga2.s1: SMS, informell/du, 3 Leitpunkte (Weg, Uhrzeit bestätigen, mitbringen), 20-30 words, rubric ga2-s1, examKey goethe_a2. The landmark list makes Leitpunkt 1 feasible. modelText is 29 words and covers all three points.

ga2.sp3: plan-together, prep 0, 180-300 s, rubric ga2-sp3, learner-leads. Calendars: learner free 9.30-10 and 14-17.30, Amal free 14-17, so there is exactly one shared window. The follow-up (Wohin? Wie? Was? Wer?) matches curriculum E4.
Originality: no text or item copies a Goethe Modellsatz. All texts are original, in the official format, and set in the unit's story.

Story: the kiosk → park → bridge route (start, LS1), the hike behind the hill (LS2), the 112 call from the bank ten minutes from the bridge (LS3), Lina's SMS, Amal's Mailbox (t2), l4 item 3 and the LS5 Sunday plan are all consistent. The cliffhanger (broken display, new contract) leads into a2.2-u05 (Handytarif). Voices: no speaker shares a voice with another in the same scene.

Register: every instruction uses Sie; the friends use du with each other; the dispatcher and Tomasz use Sie; the LS3 micro-output is Sie and the LS1/LS2 micro-outputs are du, as their situations require.

Grammar ceiling: g.lokale-praep-weg and g.werden-vollverb enter at their spine position (a2.2-u04). würde gern (a2.2-u02), wenn (a2.1-u06), the indirect question (a2.2-u03) and sich verletzen (a2.1-u08) are all licensed earlier. The only look-aheads are receptive (F10, F16).
Lexis: 28 genuinely new lemmas once lx.treffpunkt is removed (band 22-30), 14 of them productive (0.5); pools 16/12 with reserves of 4. ITM-06 passes.

Can-dos: 4 registry can-dos, each with a proof: q05 (weg-erklaeren, see F03), schreiben (wegbeschreibung-schreiben), q04 (unfall-melden) and q03 (notruf-anweisungen-folgen). All four are rehearsed in LS1, LS3, LS6 and the check.
Legal: no pass promise, no human-feedback claim, and the fokus makes no outcome claim.
